title: Jamaican Fried Dumplings Flatbread
description: Malty, crispy flatbread inspired by the monsoon season in Jamaica, perfect for a low-carb breakfast or snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together self-raising flour, sugar, and yeast.
Add the melted butter, egg, and warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Transfer the dough to a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Dust a work surface with all-purpose flour and roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Cut the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Using a rolling pin, flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat the coconut oil in the skillet or griddle over medium heat and cook the flatbreads for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Brush the flatbreads with balsamic vinegar and serve immediately.
